title: GEDCOM 7 + GEDCOM X JSON + JSON-LD export tooling
context: The corpus is built in the GEDCOM X conceptual model, but downstream consumers need interoperable export formats: GEDCOM 7 for compatibility with existing genealogy tools, GEDCOM X JSON for programmatic access, and JSON-LD for integration with the broader linked-data web. All exports must use the host-independent persistent IRI namespace committed in M0, include license metadata, and be versioned so downstream consumers can track changes. Exports are produced under CC0-1.0 where derived purely from public-domain sources.
objective: Build TypeScript/ESM export tooling that produces GEDCOM 7, GEDCOM X JSON, and JSON-LD outputs from the corpus, using the registered persistent-IRI namespace for all entity references, including license metadata in each export, and versioning exports so downstream consumers can detect updates.
acceptanceCriteria: Exports GEDCOM 7 files that open correctly in at least one GEDCOM 7-compatible tool (e.g., GRAMPS or equivalent).
Exports GEDCOM X JSON files conforming to the GEDCOM X JSON serialization specification.
Exports JSON-LD files using the registered persistent-IRI namespace for all entity IRIs and including schema.org/Wikidata context mappings.
All three exports include license metadata per dataset (CC0-1.0 for PD-derived data; other licenses noted where mixed derivations apply).
Exports are versioned (release tag and date included in export metadata) so consumers can detect updates.
Exports reference the persistent-IRI namespace (not a host-specific URL) for all entity identifiers.
pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm lint pass; export tooling committed via PR with at least one integration test validating the output of each format against the M1 batch.
output: packages/exporter/src/ (TypeScript/ESM export modules for GEDCOM 7, GEDCOM X JSON, and JSON-LD) with tests, committed via PR.
